answer.thought: The hunger is no longer a sensation but a fact, a hard point in the middle of the day. I must eat, but the house offers nothing, and the coin in my pocket is thin. I will walk to Khan Market; even in the heat, the system of needs must function for someone, and perhaps a shopkeeper will sell a single roti or a cup of tea to a man in a white kurta.
